pathways.name: Fanconi Anemia / Homologous Recombination
pathways.description: Fanconi anemia and homologous recombination repair DNA interstrand crosslinks and double-strand breaks. BRCA1/2 and PALB2 sit here. PARP inhibitors exploit HR loss.

pathways.name: Nucleotide Excision Repair (NER)
pathways.description: Nucleotide excision repair removes helix-distorting bulky DNA lesions and underlies transcription-coupled repair. Defects cause xeroderma pigmentosum and Cockayne syndrome with severe neurodegeneration.

pathways.name: Replication Fork / Replication Stress
pathways.description: Replication fork protection and stress response: RecQ helicases (WRN, BLM, RECQL4), IGHMBP2, SMARCAL1. Defects cause progeroid and motor-neuron syndromes.

pathways.name: Single-Strand Break Repair
pathways.description: Single-strand break repair mends the most frequent DNA lesions. PARP1, XRCC1, APTX, TDP1, PNKP act here. Defects cause ataxias with oculomotor apraxia.

pathways.name: DNA Damage Checkpoint
pathways.description: DNA damage checkpoint kinases ATM, CHEK1, CHEK2 coordinate the DDR response. ATM mutations cause ataxia-telangiectasia.

pathways.name: Innate Immunity / Cytosolic DNA Sensing
pathways.description: Cytosolic DNA sensing / innate immunity (TREX1, RNASEH2B, SAMHD1). DDR genes that drive neurodegeneration via neuroinflammation, not failed repair. Defects cause Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome.

pathways.name: DDR-adjacent / Membrane & Mitophagy
pathways.description: DDR-adjacent genes with membrane-trafficking / mitophagy overlap (SPG11, ZFYVE26). Defects cause hereditary spastic paraplegia with juvenile ALS-like presentation.

pathways.name: Mitochondrial DNA Repair
pathways.description: Mitochondrial DNA repair by POLG/POLG2. Defects cause Alpers-Huttenlocher syndrome, mitochondrial ataxia, parkinsonism.

pathways.name: Translesion Synthesis
pathways.description: Translesion synthesis polymerases (REV1-Pol zeta, REV7/MAD2L2) bypass lesions. REV1-MCM8 synthetic lethality is a CicciaLab flagship finding.

pathways.name: DDR Coordinator (TP53)
pathways.description: TP53 - the master DDR coordinator. Li-Fraumeni syndrome; brain tumors. The TP53-deleted RPE-1 line is the CicciaLab screening context.

pathways.name: Nucleotide Metabolism (DDR-adjacent)
pathways.description: DDR-adjacent nucleotide metabolism (ADSL). Defects cause epilepsy, autism, psychomotor retardation.
